name: Emptiness
overview: Scripture reveals that true emptiness arises when one trusts in vanity or follows a path that seems right but leads to death, as warned in Job and Proverbs. In contrast, the Lord provides fullness and righteousness to those who believe in Him, as Abraham's faith was counted for righteousness and David proclaimed the LORD as his shepherd who meets all needs. God's care is depicted as that of a shepherd guiding His people, offering comfort and provision rather than the emptiness of self-reliance. Ultimately, the suffering of Christ bore our sorrows, demonstrating that true fulfillment is found in His redemptive work rather than in empty pursuits.
